Hero.description: Whitelist server on Minecraft {mcVersion} with {createVersion}: build factories, bolt together a plane that actually flies, and lay a shared rail network across the whole world with everyone else.

HowToJoin.title: Four steps onto the server
HowToJoin.step1Description: One click on “Login” automatically creates your whitelist application. Enter your Minecraft username, done.
HowToJoin.step2Description: The application isn't complete until you're in the Discord. We check this automatically – that's where coordination happens and where you'll hear back.
HowToJoin.step3Description: Download “{modpackName}” for Prism Launcher or CurseForge. At least 6 GB RAM recommended.
HowToJoin.step4DescriptionReady: You're whitelisted: enter server IP {serverIp}, grab your starter kit at spawn, and start building.
HowToJoin.step4DescriptionPending: Once the team whitelists you, you'll find the server address here and in your dashboard.

ModpackCard.heading: Modpack {name}
ModpackCard.description: The vanilla client won't get you onto the server – you need our pack. Install it via Prism Launcher or the CurseForge app, set memory to at least {ramGb} GB, then enter the server address you get after being whitelisted.

AeronauticsHighlight.paragraph1: Create: Aeronautics is why this pack is unlike any other Create server. You assemble your aircraft block by block – fuselage, wings, engine, propeller – and then it genuinely takes off. From small biplanes to cargo airships, hot air balloons, and flying bases, it's all in there.
AeronauticsHighlight.paragraph2: There's no animation behind it – it's the physics engine Sable: weight, lift, and collisions are actually calculated. A hull that's too heavy won't leave the ground, and too little lift will drop you out of a turn. Your first build will crash almost every time – and that's exactly the fun of it.
AeronauticsHighlight.paragraph3: Because it all builds on Create, everything connects in the end: your factory on the ground produces the parts, the crane loads the freighter, and it flies the cargo to the next base.
AeronauticsHighlight.part1Text: Takes the rotation from your engine and turns it into thrust. Bigger propeller, more pull – and more power needed.
AeronauticsHighlight.part2Text: The frame. Everything attached to it becomes one connected aircraft when it takes off.
AeronauticsHighlight.part3Text: Generates the mechanical power on board. If you like it louder, use the diesel engines from the bundled addon.
AeronauticsHighlight.part4Text: Provide lift instead of thrust – the basis for airships and hot air balloons.

FeatureGrid.title: Workshop, not wasteland
FeatureGrid.description: VIP Craft 4 isn't a vanilla server with a few mods – it's a shared factory. Here are the most important features.
FeatureGrid.createDescription: Mechanical factories, Sequenced Assembly, cogwheels everywhere – the modpack is built around Create and runs stably.
FeatureGrid.aeronauticsDescription: The pack's highlight: planes, airships, and hot air balloons you build yourself, block by block. Propeller bearings provide thrust, Aeronautics chassis hold the hull together, boiler engines supply the power. Flight uses real physics – the Sable engine calculates weight and lift, and a hull that's too heavy simply won't take off.
FeatureGrid.shopsDescription: Trade using Create: Numismatics, counted in Cog. You add your own shop yourself – it's visible to everyone instantly, no approval needed.
FeatureGrid.mapDescription: BlueMap shows the whole world and who's out and about where – right in your browser.
FeatureGrid.whitelistTitle: Apply for the whitelist right here
FeatureGrid.whitelistDescription: Sign in with Discord, enter your Minecraft username, done – the application is created automatically and the team whitelists you.
FeatureGrid.railDescription: A server-wide rail network with stations at every base – planned and currently under construction. Want to help lay track? Speak up in the Discord.

ServerCountdown.comeJoinUs: Grab the modpack and come join us – we'll meet at spawn.

CookieBanner.ariaLabel: Notice about cookies and external content
CookieBanner.title: Cookies and external content
CookieBanner.paragraph1: We only use technically necessary cookies so login and forms work. These don't require consent, and there's no tracking.
CookieBanner.paragraph2: We only need your consent when content from third parties is loaded – the Twitch player and the embedded world map. Your IP address is transmitted to those providers in the process. You can change your choice any time in the footer under “Cookie settings”.
CookieBanner.necessaryDescription: Session cookie for login and CSRF protection for forms. Without these, the protected area doesn't work.
CookieBanner.categoryTwitchDescription: Shows broadcasts directly on the Streams page. Loading it transmits your IP address and browser data to Twitch; Twitch may set cookies in the process.
CookieBanner.categoryMapProvider: Provider of the embedded world map
CookieBanner.categoryMapDescription: Embeds the world map on the Map page. Loading it transmits your IP address to the map's provider.
